Formatting fixes, logging improvements and unit test refactor

Cleaning up the script, black formatting, logging formatting, pylint formatting, main() function split (also formatting) and refactoring unit test to work with less lines.

Added the prometheus_client logic and actioned various comments from the PR

The script sets up a Gauge metric, defining the name, descritpion and labels at the start. It runs a http server locally, opening on port 8000 and post the metrics to that server, using the repo labels to separate metrics.

Various type hint fixed addressing comments made on the previous commit. Updated the requirenment.txt file to include the prometheus client library

Updated unit tests and better error handling.

Made use of try and except blocks with a combination of RuntimeError to handle incorrect tokens or repos. The unit tests cover most of the lines (i think).

FEAT: A script that retreives all PRs in repo and filters by merged, with unit tests.

The script uses the PyGithub library to interact with the Github API and pulls a paginated list of PRs (objects) from a list of repositories located on a separate file separated for readability.

Because paginated lists are slow to iterate over and may quietly call the API everytime we iterate through them, a second function (retrieve_all_merged_prs) is used to create a simple non-paginated list of PR objects.

This list will be used in future functions for other metrics as it is much quicker at iterating through each PR object.

Unit tests have been developed alongside to test for as many scenarios and edge-cases as possible.

To create a local variable on the exporter VM that contains the GitHub token.

The tasks reads from an Ansible-Vault encryted secrets.yml file located on the Ansible Controller VM, and places the secret on the exporter VM with only root access so that the Python Script will have access to the token when needed.
